instruction: Review vendor invoice INV-58 from vendor V-204 against the approved purchase order PO-77 and the master services contract. Determine the payable amount, the total disputed amount, which specific line items or discrepancies are disputed, which line items are fully approved for payment, the applicable payment terms, and any risk flags. Use only INV-58 lines from vendor V-204. Exclude lines from prior invoices or different vendors. Apply PO quantities, PO unit prices, and contract authorization rules. Return only a JSON object with these fields: payable_amount, disputed_amount, dispute_items, approved_line_items, payment_terms, excluded_lines, risk_flags. payable_amount must be the total amount approved for payment. disputed_amount must be the total amount withheld pending dispute resolution. dispute_items must be an array of short snake_case labels for each disputed item type or discrepancy. approved_line_items must be an array of short snake_case labels for each approved payable item. payment_terms must be a short string describing the applicable payment terms. excluded_lines must be an array of short snake_case labels for invoice lines excluded from analysis. risk_flags must be an array of short snake_case labels for billing or contract risks identified. Do not include explanation outside the JSON.

evaluation_criteria.scoring_notes: Payable: widget 500×12=6000 + consulting 200×150=30000 + travel 800 = 36800. Disputed: widget overage 50×12=600 + rate diff 200×(165-150)=3000 + mgmt fee 2500 = 6100. Payment terms: net_30 from contract. Excluded: N1 (INV-57 prior) + N2 (V-301 wrong vendor). Risk flag: consulting rate mismatch (billed 165 vs PO 150) triggers billing pattern review per contract.
